items.title: Trial By Error: Canada’s McMaster University Launches Trial of Lightning Process for Long Covid

items.summary_short: By David Tuller, DrPH McMaster University in Hamilton, Ontario, has launched a clinical trial of the Lightning Process (LP), a well-known “mind-body” intervention, as a treatment for Long Covid. The study, called Fatigue in Long COVID, or FALCON, was registered last month on ClinicalTrials.gov.
